limitations: Weights/thresholds are team assumptions, not official TrialWatch policy.
Score is not a misuse probability, eligibility finding, or likelihood of securing release.
Source snippets are keyword retrieval hints, not automated support-gap findings.
Reviewers must verify journalist connection, court stage, current need and feasible route.
Local team reviews are unadjudicated; no model retraining or verified reviewer identity.
Closed reviews reopen for source changes or a recorded deadline becoming urgent.
